cutoff_policy_caveat.interpretation: Y/Y2/Y3 mesh trend uses the legacy policy; the new Y2 is a same-grid policy comparison against legacy Y2. Any cross-policy mesh comparison is mixed and is not a same-operator convergence certificate.
cutoff_policy_caveat.legacy_identity_evidence: source-bound dtn_port_3d.py at each run SHA has all three production cutoff sites using the absolute floor; policy was not separately serialized into those old manifests

limitations: All cases remain finite R13 operators; FULL_DTN_NOT_VERIFIED is retained.
The new relative-only Y2 differs in sparse extraction policy from legacy Y/Y2/Y3; this is not an isolated mesh refinement comparison.
Saved E/H arrays cover the specified common sample grid only, not the full field or canonical pillar sidewall trace.
R/T classifications and power values are those stored by each run; no uncomputed modes are filled as zero beyond the 612-mode active rectangle.
Legacy raw projection audit failures remain historical evidence and are not overwritten by the boundary-scaled alpha/recovery comparison.

method.complex_modal_comparison: all 612 ordered active mode records; exact common mode keys, beta and boundary phase; no phase fit
method.field_comparison: saved complex samples at exactly equal coordinates; no phase fitting and no interpolation

method.sample_npz_access_note: Two earlier export attempts had already loaded each permitted small NPZ once before failing at output permissions / JSON serialization; the final export pass reread each once to save the comparison.
